verdict.rationale: The README documents vendor-specific acceleration: custom CUDA kernels for NVIDIA GPUs, AMD support via HIP, Moore Threads via MUSA, and Apple Metal. Users report real CUDA speedups in hands-on use, though one cites only about a 2x gain on a 4090. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party backend documentation beyond README bullet points, and hands-on corroboration for AMD/HIP or other non-NVIDIA GPU backends.
